out_of_scope_observations.observation: anyMealSelectedId (line 214-215) is computed inside _buildMealsCandidateGroup but never read. It is dead code. The actual per-option selection check at line 232-235 is correct and covers all 3 meal slots. No functional impact.

.card.tap-selected uses box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--drop-target) where --drop-target is #b3d0f7 (blue). The BA spec says 'no colored box-shadow' on cards but allows 'flat zero-spread shadow for focus rings'. This is a 2px spread outline-style shadow on a functional state (.tap-selected), not a decorative shadow on the base card — consistent with the focus-ring carve-out. Noted for designer review.
